title: T10 — Gap analysis (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Gap Analysis — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches

## Baseline

The V1 audit's measured state at the rework: eight findings open against T10, of which the
material ones are `v1-p82-5` (WSJF materialisation proved for a project backlog, not the
programme-wide one), `v1-p83-1` (free-text placeholders satisfy the demo evidence check) and
`v1-p83-4` (the baseline requirement before realisation is not gated). The tranche-4
authorisation was absent when T10 closed — recorded as the accepted exception `U3-EXC-T10` — and
is now carried by the tr4 review.

## Target

The five §12 clauses, each an executable test: WSJF materialisation within WIP behind an
approved plan (`programme_cadence.rs`, `cadence_jobs.rs`); typed demo evidence (`demo_gate.rs`);
a retro lesson requirement (`retro.rs`); an evidence-gated tranche review
(`tranche_review.rs`); a baseline before realisation (`benefit_transition.rs`). Plus the
retrospective record itself: charter, baseline, A–D set, contract, Phase-G review, the published
outputs and the closure chain.

## Gaps and work packages

- **Open findings:** `v1-p82-5`, `v1-p83-1`, `v1-p83-4` and the other five T10 findings are
  carried in the conformance ledger; none is waived (decision 0012).
- **Standard/code:** the demo gate must refuse free text; the tranche baseline must be a gate
  condition — code packages owned by T10's finding set.
- **Record:** the tranche-4 authorisation (now recorded by the tr4 review) and the closure
  exception (`U3-EXC-T10`, accepted).
